notes:
Company background: large seasonal DTC & marketplace. Catalog ~45M SKUs (variants included), expects 3x traffic during holiday windows. Search is primary revenue funnel.

Current infra: hybrid — product catalog in their cloud SQL + images in S3, search built on Elastic clusters + a homegrown re-ranker using CPU-based models. Vector store experimentation with Pinecone (pilot). Latency issues when traffic spikes; batch rerank currently runs async causing poor CTR.

Customer goals: reduce cost-per-query for semantic search + rerank, get p99 latency under 200ms for frontend searches, support A/B experiments for reranker models, ensure EU data residency for EU customers. Tight budget for hosted tokens; interested in quantization and batching guidance.

Quotes / call snippets: "We need consistent sub-200ms P99 in peak hours — anything slower kills conversion." — Search PM.

POC scope agreed: index 5M prioritized SKUs (holiday catalog), evaluate embedding index options (in-memory vs vector DB), implement a 2-stage retrieval + rerank (dense retrieve -> lightweight candidate rerank on GPU), measure cost per query at 100QPS and at 10k QPS burst. Deliverable: cost model and runbook for seasonal scaling.

Risk notes: marketing requires hard SLA for peak days; procurement pushing for SOC2 + contractual data residency clauses. Infra wants egress estimate before green light.
